_README: Curated display annotations for the FY26 checkbook. vendor_aliases maps raw ledger vendor strings to a canonical raw string (merging spelling variants and repairing names the portal export doubled or truncated at 50 characters); the underlying CSV is unchanged and remains the source of record. vendor_notes are one-line identifications shown in the Top vendors card; each is verifiable from the funds the vendor is paid from in the CSV or from the page's Notes section. fund_labels and division_overrides re-format the ledger's own Town Meeting article codes (A11 2022 = Article 11, 2022 Annual Town Meeting); they add no information beyond expanding the code, except where marked. description_patterns rewrites cryptic AP-side invoice strings into human-readable labels at render time (regex with $1/$2/... capture group refs); the raw ledger string stays in the CSV and on row hover. label_notes adds a short explanation shown on hover for opaque budget-portal labels (Other Expense, Other Governmental, Districtwide, OFU, etc.). fund_families assigns each of the 105 funds to a family by name pattern, hand reviewed.

vendor_aliases.MA MUNICIPAL AUDITORS & ACCOUNTANTS ASSO: MA MUNICIPAL AUDITORS & ACCOUNTANTS ASSOCIATION INC
vendor_aliases.PUBLIC UTILITY MUTUAL INSURANCE COMPANY: PUBLIC UTILITY MUTUAL INSURANCE COMPANY (PUMIC RRG)
vendor_aliases.FITCHBURG, LEOMINSTER, LANCASTER, & CLIN: FITCHBURG, LEOMINSTER, LANCASTER & CLINTON ED COLLABORATIVE

vendor_notes.COMMONWEALTH OF MA: Mostly GIC health insurance premiums, plus state assessments and pass-through fees
vendor_notes.BERKSHIRE WIND POWER COOPERATIVE CORP: Light Department wholesale power purchases, all paid from the Electric Enterprise fund
vendor_notes.MARBLEHEAD CONTRIBUTORY RETIREMENT SYSTE: The town's annual pension appropriation, plus the enterprise funds' shares
vendor_notes.MASSACHUSETTS WATER RESOURCES AUTHORITY: Regional wholesale water supplier and sewer-project lender
vendor_notes.MARBLEHEAD LIGHT DEPT: Town and school departments paying the municipal Light Department for electricity
vendor_notes.ONE TIME PAY: The ledger's bucket for one-off payees, not a company
vendor_notes.MIIA HEALTH BENEFITS TRUST: Insurance through the Massachusetts Municipal Association's joint-purchase trust
vendor_notes.NICKS LUXURY TRANSPORTATION INC: Student transportation, paid from school and special-education funds

label_notes.OTHER EXPENSE: Munis catch-all for spending that doesn't fit the named categories (Professional Salary, Contracted Services, etc.). Often the second-largest category in any fund.
label_notes.OTHER SALARIES: Compensation lines that aren't Professional or Clerical - usually part-time, overtime, stipends, and seasonal staff.
label_notes.OFU: Other Financing Uses - inter-fund transfers and other financing transactions, not operating spend.
label_notes.GOVERNMENTAL: Generic municipal-budget label for general-government spending that isn't broken out by department.
label_notes.OTHER GOVERNMENTAL: Catch-all department for general-government spending not assigned to a named department (Town Manager, Selectmen, Town Clerk, etc.).
label_notes.DISTRICTWIDE: School-side catch-all for spending that isn't tied to one school building (health insurance, district administration, special education).
label_notes.STATE ASSESSMENTS: Annual charges Marblehead owes the Commonwealth (MBTA, school choice tuition, charter school assessments, etc.).
label_notes.UNKNOWN: The town's accounting system did not classify these rows. Usually a data-entry gap, not a real budget category.
label_notes.INTERFUND TRANSFERS: Money moved from one town fund to another (e.g. general fund to OPEB trust), not new spending.
label_notes.DEBT SERVICE: Annual payments on the town's outstanding bonds (principal plus interest).

division_overrides.ART 26 2022 ESSEX NS AGGIE & T: 2022 ATM Art. 26: Essex North Shore Agricultural & Technical School

description_patterns.note: Commonwealth GIC bills the town once a month for the employer share of state-pool health insurance, split across General Fund and each enterprise fund (sewer/water/electric/harbor) by employee assignment. Captures both the dashed (666-0168-2025-0709MB) and packed (666016820250903MB) AP-entry formats.
